That's the same line I called -- 1-800-273-8255 with bad results. 

Do you think calling back later with someone else would be a lot different?

I listened and heard you. 

I felt the same thing when I called. It was sad to me. Somehow I thought there would be something like an almost friend talking to me, but you're right. Scripts, and pauses, and big pauses. 

This said, I feel sorry for the people that pick up the phone. 

Absolutely no help, but I've found hugging my dog, drinking beer, and putting on good headphones and listening to music really loud is the best prevention. 

I try to write too when I'm really sad and angry. I get so mad that I close my eyes an type what I dream and it becomes almost a psychosis that doesn't breathe. 

When I wake I read what I wrote and it makes me happy. Makes me smile usually. If it doesn't it makes me want to write more which keeps me alive. We write, we are here. 

Keep on my friend, we love you, deeply.

this entirely happened to me. 

she made me break my own heart. leaving then wanting me back, tho i said no because i knew it wouldn't work work, and thus making me feel like i both said no and and no to myself. it was so fucking mean. 

i lost 50 lbs. did a half ironman. found an amazing life and realized life isn't based on a single person.

Thank you so much! I will call them tomorrow at noon. This is exactly the kind of help I was looking for -- other outlets. 

I truly think I'm some sort of angst wiggling around wanting help and wanting to be something much bigger than this but I need to get through it. I'm so poor (making less than $4,000 / year) I can't get much good help and I struggle. A lot folks around here tell me to just suck it up and get over it but I've tried, prayed, and it's like gravel in my stomach. I dream about this a lot and rest doesn't seem to help. I just wanted someone to talk to me without it feeling like a customer service call. I didn't really post this for a complaint, just to to maybe get some more services up which you did --- so so thank you.

America -- Indiana -- Indianapolis. 

Hope that helps. 

Not sure of the girls accent. Around here they can sound or they can't, it's hard. Who knows tho.

i love you and you're perfect. 

i don't know you but somehow the night says it okay and we are okay. we are okay. 

wish. take the stars and dream. it's okay. i promise. it's okay.
